title: Nexus Fundamentals
description: Every new hire takes it: sign in and set up your phone, punch in and fix a missed punch, sign your Time Sheet, request time off and HR help, report problems with tickets and forms, and take training. Course 1 of the Greens Storage Academy.
overview: Sign in, find your way around and set up Nexus on your phone
Punch in, take breaks, punch out and fix a missed punch
Read and sign your Time Sheet
Confirm your schedule and request time off
Use Ask HR, Reimbursements and Purchase Requests
Get help with tickets, Report a Problem and forms
Find people, borrow equipment, keep notes and take your training

questions.q: You arrive at Escondido 25 minutes before your shift and tap Punch In. Nexus shows Early Clock-In. Your manager did not ask you to start early. What do you tap?
questions.explanation: Choose Not Yet and punch in closer to your start time. Clock In Anyway records the punch and your manager is told about early punches; only start early when your manager asked you to.

questions.q: You forgot to punch out yesterday. This morning the Time Clock shows a red bar about a clock-in that was never closed. What is the right fix?
options: Punch in and then punch out right away to close the shift
Tap Fix My Punch Out and ask for the real clock-out time with a reason
Ignore it; payroll fixes it at the end of the period
Ask a coworker to punch you out
questions.explanation: Fix My Punch Out takes you to your Time Sheet to request the real clock-out time with a reason; your approver decides. Punching again creates a second, wrong shift.

questions.q: If your phone's location is turned off, Nexus refuses your punch until you turn it on.
questions.explanation: A punch never waits for your location and is never blocked by it. A clock-in with location off shows Location Off, and a Needs Attention bar offers Turn On or Skip.

questions.q: At the back of the Temecula lot you tap Punch Out with no signal. A box says Your Punch Did Not Record and that the punch is saved on this device. What should you do?
options: Punch out again until it works
Nothing more: tap OK, Keep Trying or Retry Now once you have signal
Punch in and out again at the office
Delete the app and reinstall it
questions.explanation: A punch saved on the device keeps trying on its own and goes in at the time you pressed the button. Do not punch again to fix it; that would create a wrong punch.

questions.q: Put the steps for taking a lunch break in order.
options: Type a short reason in the Going on break box
Tap End Break when you are back
questions.explanation: Start Break opens the Going on break box, which needs a reason, then Start break & notify. When you return, End Break opens Resuming work and End break & notify puts you back on the clock.

questions.q: You punch in from the office computer instead of your phone. What will your Time Sheet most likely show for that punch?
options: The exact unit number you were standing at
questions.explanation: A computer usually gives only a rough location, so the punch shows Approx. Location. Punch from your phone on site for a precise location that shows the site name.

questions.q: Which statements about the Beginning of Day message are true? Pick all that apply.
options: It posts to your team's Teams chat as you, marked Sent by Nexus
If you already sent it another way, you can tick I already sent my login (BOD) message
Some field roles skip the message boxes entirely
It is sent only to HR and nobody else sees it
questions.explanation: The message posts to your team chat as you. The tick box skips posting again, and some roles are set up with no boxes at all. It is not a private message to HR.

questions.q: You get a Still on Break? notice in your bell. What does it most likely mean?
options: Your manager wants you to take a longer break
You started a break a long time ago and probably forgot to tap End Break
questions.explanation: Still on Break? comes when a break stays open for a long time (60 minutes by default). Tap End Break now, and if the time is wrong, fix it on your Time Sheet.

questions.q: You forgot to punch out yesterday at Murrieta. Today your Time Sheet shows a red Missing cell. What do you do?
options: Punch out now so the shift closes
Click Missing, enter the real time you left, give a reason and send the request
questions.explanation: Click the red Missing cell to open Request a Missing Punch, enter the real time and a reason. It shows Not Yet Approved until your approver decides.

questions.q: A coworker says to check the Tickets module, but you do not see Tickets in your left menu. What is going on?
options: Nexus is broken; restart your phone
You have not been granted that module; use Help Center or ask your manager for access
questions.explanation: Menus differ because grants open modules on top of your tier. Everyone can raise and follow tickets from Help Center; ask your manager if you need the desk module.

questions.q: The keypad on gate 2 at Fairfield stops responding. What is the best way to report it?
options: Write it in your Today note
Submit a Ticket in Help Center with a clear title, a photo and the right priority
questions.explanation: A ticket reaches the right team, is tracked and shows its status. A clear title like Gate 2 keypad not responding and a photo save a trip and a call.

questions.q: You have a dentist appointment next Thursday from 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM. How do you ask for the time?
options: Workday > Time Off > Request Time Off, reason Medical Appointment, All day off, set the times, then Request
Punch out at 1:00 PM without asking
questions.explanation: Request Time Off with the Medical Appointment reason and All day turned off for part of a day. Your manager decides and you get a bell.

questions.q: Your vacation day last Monday was approved, but your Time Sheet shows no hours that day. What do you do?
options: Click Add on Monday, pick the Type Vacation, set the hours and send it
Punch in and out on Monday
questions.explanation: Approved time off is not punched in for you. Add it on your Time Sheet with the Type Vacation (or Sick) so it is paid.

questions.q: You opened a new bank account and need your pay to go there. What do you do?
options: Edit the bank details yourself under Contact & Emergency
Open Ask HR, New Request, Profile Change, and click Send to HR
questions.explanation: Name, job, department and bank details change through Ask HR, Profile Change. Ask HR is confidential, and HR will tell you what to send.

questions.q: Your manager asked you to buy receipt paper with your own money at Valley Center. How do you get paid back?
options: Reimbursements: New, Supplies, the business purpose, the receipt photo, then Send for Approval
Put the receipt in a note
questions.explanation: Reimbursements pays you back for company expenses you paid yourself. Attach the receipt and say why it was a company expense.

questions.q: You fill the site inspection form at the back of the lot with no signal and tap Send. It shows Saved on This Phone. What next?
options: Fill the form again at the office
Nothing; it sends itself when signal returns, or tap Sync Now on the bar
Email the form to your manager
questions.explanation: Entries saved on the phone send themselves when signal comes back, and the same entry sent twice is still one entry. Do not refill it.

questions.q: Your Time Sheet was approved, but you notice Thursday is missing a 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM shift you worked. What do you do?
options: Sign it anyway and fix it next period
Decline in Nexus Sign with a reason, or ask for a punch fix on Thursday
Ask a coworker to sign it for you
Punch in and out now for three hours
questions.explanation: Either a punch fix request or declining in Nexus Sign with a reason sends it back to your manager. Never sign hours you know are wrong.

questions.q: You borrowed a ladder from Item Management and are done with it. How do you return it?
options: In My Stuff, click Start Return, take a photo, pick the Condition, then Confirm Return
questions.explanation: Start Return with a photo and the condition is the return. Until it is confirmed in Nexus, the ladder is still yours on the record.

questions.q: Which question is answered in Nexus rather than in Cubby?
options: What is a new tenant's gate code?
How many hours did I work this week?
questions.explanation: Your own hours live in your Time Sheet in Nexus. Tenant, unit, payment and gate code questions are Cubby.

questions.q: Put the five Nexus tiers in order from level 1 to level 5.
questions.explanation: The tiers run Employee (1), Supervisor (2), Manager (3), Administrator (4) and Super Administrator (5).

questions.q: Beside a person's name you see an outline shield. What does it mean?
questions.explanation: An outline shield marks an Administrator, a filled shield a Super Administrator, and a small people icon a Manager. Under the name Nexus shows the job title.

questions.q: Two Employees at the same site always see exactly the same left menu.
questions.explanation: Grants from a job role or Access Groups open extra modules on top of the tier, so two Employees can see different menus.

questions.q: Which sign-in button does a Greens employee use?
questions.explanation: Greens employees use Team Sign-In with their Microsoft work account. Partner Sign-In is for outside partners and sends a code by email.

questions.q: After a few weeks, the policy notice appears again when you sign in. Why?
options: The company published a new version of its policies
You signed in from a new phone
questions.explanation: The policy notice comes back each time a new version is published. Read it, tick the box and click Accept & Continue.

questions.q: What is the fastest way to open Search Nexus from anywhere on a computer?
options: Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on a Mac) or the / key
questions.explanation: Ctrl+K, Cmd+K on a Mac, or the / key jumps to Search Nexus on any screen.

questions.q: Which of these are in the header across the top of Nexus? Pick all that apply.
questions.explanation: The header holds Search Nexus, the + menu, the bell, the ? Help panel and your profile menu. Nexus has no chat of its own; people talk on Teams.

questions.q: You used the shared office computer at Valley Center. What should you do at the end of your shift?
options: Click your initials, then Sign Out
questions.explanation: Sign Out stops the next person from acting as you and clears the offline copy of your data on that device.

questions.q: How do you install Nexus on an iPhone?
options: In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen
Download it from the App Store
questions.explanation: iPhones install web apps only from Safari: Share, then Add to Home Screen. Then open Nexus from the new icon.

questions.q: Where do you turn on Push to This Device?
questions.explanation: Profile > Phone Notifications has Install Nexus and Push to This Device.

questions.q: Push to This Device says: Not available in this browser. On an iPhone, install Nexus first and open it from the home screen. What do you do?
options: Install Nexus from Safari and open it from the home screen icon, then turn push on
questions.explanation: On an iPhone, push only works in the installed app. Install it from Safari, open it from the icon, and turn the switch on.

questions.q: Company announcements are not showing on your Dashboard Home. Why?
options: Announcements reach the Dashboard only through the Announcements widget, which is not on Home by default
questions.explanation: Add it with Customize, Add Widget, Announcements, then Save and Done. Acknowledge a post that asks you to.

questions.q: You clicked Clear All in the bell by mistake. Can you get a notice back?
options: Yes, cleared notices stay under Closed for 30 days
Only an administrator can restore it
questions.explanation: Clearing moves notices to Closed, where they stay for 30 days and can be restored.

questions.q: A yellow bar appears across the top of every screen. What is it?
options: A priority notice for something that needs you now, such as a Time Sheet to sign
questions.explanation: The yellow priority bar is for must-act items. Open goes to the item, and acting on it clears the bar.

questions.q: Which Dashboard tile counts documents waiting for your signature?
questions.explanation: Signatures Needed counts documents awaiting your signature. A document waiting on you can hold up your onboarding or your pay.

questions.q: Which are tabs in Workday? Pick all that apply.
questions.explanation: Workday has Overview, Time Sheet, Time Off and Performance. Inventory is an Item Management tab for managers.

questions.q: Your emergency contact changed. How do you update it?
options: Workday Overview, Contact & Emergency, Edit, then Save
questions.explanation: You edit your own personal email, phone and emergency contact under Contact & Emergency. Name, job, department and bank changes go through Ask HR.

questions.q: Where are your paystubs and signed copies of documents?
options: In My Documents on the Workday Overview
questions.explanation: My Documents holds signed copies, files HR filed for you, and your paystubs, in folders.

questions.q: In an HR document such as a hiring packet form, the company signs before you do.
questions.explanation: You always sign first. The company never signs before the employee; any company signature is added after yours.

questions.q: Which buttons does the Time Clock show while you are on a break?
questions.explanation: The clock only shows valid buttons. On a break, End Break puts you back on the clock.

questions.q: Your Time Sheet shows Out of Location for a punch. What does it mean?
options: You punched at a company site
The punch was made away from every company location and is flagged for review
questions.explanation: Out of Location means the punch was away from all company locations. Location is checked only at the punch, never between punches.

questions.q: You have been clocked in for 11 hours and an amber banner asks if you are still working. You are. What do you tap?
questions.explanation: I'm Still Working hides the banner when it is true. Fix My Punch Out is for a forgotten clock-out.

questions.q: You are an hourly team member at a California site and missed your meal break on Tuesday. What do you do when your Time Sheet is ready to sign?
options: Click Report a Missed Break, pick Tuesday and Meal, then Send Back to Manager
questions.explanation: Signing confirms the meal and rest break statement. Hourly California staff report a missed break instead of signing, and the manager adds the premium pay. Training only, not legal advice.

questions.q: You work at a Texas site. The signing screen shows the meal and rest break statement, and it is not true for you. What should you do?
options: Sign it to get paid on time
Tell your manager first; if it is still not true, decline it in Nexus Sign with a reason
questions.explanation: Never sign a statement that is not true. Report a Missed Break appears only for hourly staff on the California rule, so at a Texas site tell your manager first, then decline with a reason if it is still not true. Training only, not legal advice.

questions.q: How does your Time Sheet show eight hours and fifteen minutes?
questions.explanation: Hours read as hours and minutes, like 8:15. Nexus never shows decimal hours on screen.

questions.q: You sent a missing punch request. How does that day look until your approver decides?
questions.explanation: A request shows on its day as Not Yet Approved until your approver decides. Follow it under Change Requests This Period.

questions.q: Who signs your Time Sheet?
questions.explanation: Your manager approves with Review & Approve, but only you sign. Your signature finalizes the period for payroll.

questions.q: Put the Time Sheet approval and signing steps in order.
options: You get a bell and an email that it is approved
You click Sign & Submit and sign in Nexus Sign
The signed copy is filed in My Documents
questions.explanation: You do not need to submit first. After the period ends your manager approves, you are told, you sign, and the signed copy is filed.

questions.q: HR corrected your Time Sheet after you signed it. What are you asked to do?
options: Sign Updated Time Sheet, or decline it with what is wrong
questions.explanation: When HR changes a signed Time Sheet, you check what changed and Sign Updated Time Sheet, or decline it with what is wrong.

questions.q: A banner in My Schedule says your schedule was shared and asks you to have a look and confirm. What does Confirm mean?
options: You agree to every shift forever
You are asking for a swap
questions.explanation: Confirm means you have seen it. If something does not work, confirm and then talk to your manager or use a shift request if your company allows them.

questions.q: Shift swaps, offers and releases are on for every company by default.
questions.explanation: They are off by default, and each company decides whether to turn them on. If you see no Request button under your shifts, handle changes with your manager.

questions.q: A teammate accepted your swap request. Which shift do you work?
options: Your original shift, until a manager approves the swap
questions.explanation: A swap waits on your teammate, then on a manager. Until it is approved, the original schedule stands.

questions.q: You were sick yesterday and could not request time off in time. How do you ask for it?
options: Click Request for a Past Date on the Time Off form
Add a note on the Dashboard
questions.explanation: Past dates are grayed out on the form. Request for a Past Date lets you ask for one you missed.

questions.q: An hourly team member who does not work on a company holiday is paid for that day.
questions.explanation: Company holidays are unpaid days off for hourly staff, with the office closed. Hours actually worked on a holiday are paid as usual.

questions.q: Which Ask HR choice do you use for an employment verification letter for a new apartment?
questions.explanation: Request a Letter covers employment verification, salary, visa and more, when your company offers HR letters.

questions.q: You do not have the receipt yet for something you bought for the site. Can you still file the reimbursement?
options: Yes; send it now and use Add Receipt later. HR approves it once the receipt is attached
questions.explanation: You can send it without the receipt and add it later. HR approves the claim once the receipt is attached.

questions.q: Your reimbursement came back Sent Back with a note that the receipt photo is blurry. What do you do?
options: Open it, fix what the note says, and click Fix and Resubmit
questions.explanation: A sent back claim is fixed in place: read What to fix, make the change, and click Fix and Resubmit.

questions.q: A ticket you raised shows Waiting for User. What should you do?
options: Reply; the team is waiting on you
questions.explanation: Waiting for User means the team needs something from you. The ticket cannot move until you answer.

questions.q: The team resolved your ticket, but the problem is still there. What do you do?
options: Click Reopen while it is still Resolved, and say why
questions.explanation: Reopen with a reason while it is Resolved. Once a ticket is Closed it stays closed, and a problem that comes back is a new ticket.

questions.q: You scan a QR tag at the end of a building. What can you do from the page that opens?
options: See Open Tickets there and Report a Problem with Where, Details and Photos
questions.explanation: A place tag opens that place: Open Tickets shows what is already reported, and Report a Problem files a ticket already linked to the property.

questions.q: The offline bar says something needs your choice. What is happening?
options: Your phone is out of storage
Someone else changed the same record, and you pick Keep Mine or Use Theirs
questions.explanation: Nexus never silently overwrites anyone's change. When two changes meet, you choose Keep Mine or Use Theirs.

questions.q: Nexus has its own chat for messaging coworkers.
questions.explanation: Greens talks on Microsoft Teams. Nexus has no chat of its own; Chat, Message on Teams and Call on Teams open Teams.

questions.q: Which step does NOT need a photo in Item Management?
options: Confirming receipt of a borrowed item
questions.explanation: Photos are evidence at handover, receipt and return. A lost item has no photo to take, so Report Lost needs none.

questions.q: Who can open a note you wrote in Notes?
options: Only you and the people you share it with
questions.explanation: A note is private to its owner and the people it is shared with. A name typed in a note notifies nobody.

questions.q: A checkpoint inside a course uses one of your final quiz tries.
questions.explanation: A checkpoint is practice and does not count as a quiz try. Use it to find what to reread.

questions.q: You scored 76% on the final quiz. What should you do before you try again?
options: Read the lessons listed under Reread these before you try again
Ask a coworker for the answers
questions.explanation: The quiz needs 80%. Reread the listed lessons first; the next try draws different questions, so understanding works and guessing does not.

questions.q: How long do you have to finish the Greens Storage Academy as a new facility hire?
questions.explanation: The New Hire: Facility Team plan is due 30 days from your start date. Your manager is told if a course runs past its due date.

questions.q: You passed a Greens Storage Academy course. When do you have to retake it?
options: Never; the certificate does not expire. You can reread the lessons any time.
questions.explanation: Each academy course issues a certificate on pass with no renewal. A passed quiz is not taken again, but you can reread any lesson whenever you want a refresher.

questions.q: How do you sign a Read and Sign policy?
options: Read it to the end, type your full name under Read, Then Sign Below, and sign
Ask your manager to sign for you
questions.explanation: Read to the end, type your full name and sign that version. A real policy change asks you to sign again.
